subject: gradeQuiz cannot score a drawn subset (blocks pool-draw delivery)
description: functions/index.js:1704 computes 'const total = answerKey.length', the full bank, while QuizEngine posts an answerMap containing only the drawn questions. Any quiz combining poolSize with serverGrading marks a perfect student wrong on every undrawn slot: 12 of 20 scored 60% and failed. Found by Chris 2026-08-07 on forge-ch25, which was the only quiz in the app combining the two, so nothing had exercised it. The assessment standard REQUIRES pool-draw delivery, so this blocks that standard for every server-graded quiz. Fix needs a distinct served-count (key doc field or count of submitted keys, validated so a 1-answer submission cannot score 100%), a functions deploy, and a regression sweep across the 415 files using serverGrading.
